smith.scroll.title: Benison Scroll
smith.scroll.tip: Read a Benison Scroll over this attempt: +{pts} points of success chance (never above 100%) for {mult}× the Yeop. The Metin shard cost does not change, and a failed attempt still uses the scroll up. It reads over spare Yeop only, never the Yeop a plain attempt still needs.
smith.scroll.cappedTip: This step cannot fail, so a scroll would add nothing.
smith.scroll.shortTip: A Benison Scroll costs {mult}× the Yeop of the attempt: {yeop} in all.
smith.scroll.aria: Benison Scroll: success chance {blessed} instead of {base}, costs {yeop} Yeop
smith.result.failScroll: The scroll is spent. Your +{n} is safe.
smith.scroll.lockedTip: Sinks the late-game Yeop surplus: +{pts} points of success chance for {mult}× the Yeop. It opens once the last zone is cleared on Normal, and even then only over Yeop your plain attempts do not need; until then every Yeop is better spent on plain attempts.
smith.scroll.ariaLocked: Benison Scroll: opens after the Normal campaign
smith.scroll.reserveTip: The scroll never takes the Yeop of a plain attempt. Your Metin shards pay for {n} plain attempts at {y} Yeop each, and those come first: the scroll opens once the purse also covers its extra {extra} Yeop ({reserve} in all).
smith.scroll.reserveAria: Benison Scroll: keeps your Yeop for plain attempts, {n} more Yeop needed
smith.scroll.reserveToast: The scroll keeps your Yeop for plain attempts: {n} more Yeop opens it.
smith.fail.scrollLocked: The Benison Scroll opens once the last zone is cleared on Normal.
smith.fail.scrollUseless: This step cannot fail: a scroll would add nothing.
smith.fail.scrollNotSpare: The scroll reads over spare Yeop only: your plain attempts come first.
smith.scroll.shortToast: A Benison Scroll costs {yeop} Yeop here: {n} more Yeop opens it.
smith.scroll.cappedToast: This step cannot fail, so a scroll would add nothing.
smith.scroll.cappedAria: Benison Scroll: this step is already certain, a scroll would add nothing
smith.scroll.shortAria: Benison Scroll: {n} more Yeop needed ({yeop} Yeop in all)
